lines.text: Many learners say: We must deal the problem now.
Better: We must deal with the problem now.
Deal needs with before the problem you solve.
Deal with! We must deal with the problem now.

data.wrong: We must deal the problem now.
data.right: We must deal with the problem now.
data.why: Deal needs with before the problem you solve.
